title: PhysDEM: Physics-Defined Energy-Matching Diffusion for Spatiotemporal Field Generation under Scarce Measurements
title_zh: PhysDEM：物理定义的能量匹配扩散用于稀缺测量下的时空场生成

paragraphs.en: Generating and predicting spatiotemporal physical fields from scarce measurements is challenging, as observations are insufficient to characterize a distribution over complete fields. This limits conventional data-driven diffusion models that rely on full-field datasets. We introduce PhysDEM , a physics-defined diffusion framework that combines governing equations with spatially sparse observations to generate multiple plausible fields. First, we construct a Gibbs target by reweighting a measurement-conditioned Gaussian reference with PDE residual energy. Second, we derive an exact conditional-mean identity that reduces denoising to supervised learning of the standardized energy-induced mean correction. Third, a physics-displacement probability flow cancels Gaussian reference terms and enables amortized sampling with changing measurements through Gaussian conditioning, without retraining. Experiments on synthetic PDE systems and real-world-informed applications demonstrate that PhysDEM supports coherent field recovery and efficient sampling while maintaining stable diagnostics under tested noise levels, illustrating its practical value for field assessment. To our knowledge, PhysDEM is the first physics-defined diffusion model enabling amortized spatiotemporal field inference without preassembled full-field datasets.
paragraphs.zh: 从稀疏测量数据中生成和预测时空物理场是一项具有挑战性的任务，因为观测数据不足以描述完整物理场的分布。 这限制了依赖完整物理场数据集的传统数据驱动扩散模型。 我们提出了 PhysDEM——一种基于物理定律的扩散框架，它将控制方程与空间稀疏观测数据相结合，以生成多个合理的物理场。 首先，我们通过用偏微分方程残差能量重新加权测量条件高斯参考分布，构建了一个吉布斯目标分布。 其次，我们推导出了一个精确的条件均值恒等式，该恒等式将去噪过程简化为对标准化能量诱导的均值修正进行监督学习。 第三，一种基于物理位移的概率流抵消了高斯参考项，并通过高斯条件化实现了在测量数据变化时的摊销采样，而无需重新训练。 在合成偏微分方程系统和基于真实世界信息的应用中的实验表明，PhysDEM 支持连贯的物理场恢复和高效采样，并在测试的噪声水平下保持稳定的诊断能力，这体现了其在物理场评估中的实际价值。 据我们所知，PhysDEM 是首个基于物理定律的扩散模型，它无需预组装完整物理场数据集即可实现时空物理场的摊销推断。

paragraphs.en: Generating and predicting spatiotemporal physical fields is essential for scientific modeling. To address this task, generative artificial intelligence uses neural networks to learn probability distributions over plausible field realizations and generate new fields by sampling from these distributions. Diffusion models, in particular, generate samples from high-dimensional distributions through iterative denoising ( Song et al., 2020 ) . Their key strengths include training stability, sample fidelity, distributional coverage ( Dhariwal & Nichol, 2021 ) , and flexible conditioning ( Song et al., 2020 ; Rozet & Louppe, 2023 ) , supporting the generation of spatially detailed field ensembles that represent diverse temporal evolutions and their uncertainty ( Price et al., 2025 ; Rozet & Louppe, 2023 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 生成和预测时空物理场对于科学建模至关重要。 为了解决这一任务，生成式人工智能利用神经网络学习合理场实现上的概率分布，并通过从这些分布中采样来生成新的场。 特别是，扩散模型通过迭代去噪从高维分布中生成样本（Song et al., 2020）。 它们的关键优势包括训练稳定性、样本保真度、分布覆盖性（Dhariwal & Nichol, 2021）以及灵活的条件约束（Song et al., 2020; Rozet & Louppe, 2023），从而支持生成具有空间细节的场集合，这些集合能够代表多样的时间演化及其不确定性（Price et al., 2025; Rozet & Louppe, 2023）。

paragraphs.en: Most existing diffusion models for physical-field generation are data-driven . Some learn physical patterns implicitly from extensive reanalysis or simulation datasets ( Price et al., 2025 ; Rozet & Louppe, 2023 ) , whereas others explicitly incorporate governing partial differential equations (PDEs) through physics-informed training losses ( Bastek et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) or sampling guidance ( Huang et al., 2024 ; Jacobsen et al., 2025 ) . Both strategies typically rely on large collections of complete fields for training. This dependence limits their applicability when the available data consist only of scarce measurements, with time series recorded at a handful of spatial locations. These scarce measurements alone are insufficient to characterize a distribution over complete fields.
paragraphs.zh: 大多数现有的用于物理场生成的扩散模型都是数据驱动的。 一些模型通过大量重新分析或模拟数据集隐式地学习物理模式（Price 等人，2025；Rozet & Louppe，2023），而另一些模型则通过物理信息引导的训练损失（Bastek 等人，2025；Wang 等人，2026）或采样引导（Huang 等人，2024；Jacobsen 等人，2025）明确引入控制性的偏微分方程（PDE）。 这两种策略通常都需要依赖大量完整的场数据集进行训练。 当可用数据仅包含稀疏的测量值，且时间序列仅在少数几个空间位置记录时，这种依赖性会限制模型的应用范围。 仅凭这些稀疏的测量值不足以描述完整场的分布。

paragraphs.en: To address this limitation, we propose a physics-driven diffusion framework for spatiotemporal field generation, in which physics defines the target distribution, and measurements provide constraints . We use the governing equations to define a PDE residual energy and construct a target distribution from which we sample training fields, without requiring a preassembled full-field dataset from real-world measurements or external simulators. Once trained, the model serves as an amortized sampler, using scarce measurements at a handful of spatial locations to rapidly estimate unobserved field values and explore diverse plausible evolutions of complete spatiotemporal fields.
paragraphs.zh: 为了解决这一局限性，我们提出了一种基于物理的扩散框架，用于生成时空场。在该框架中，物理定律定义了目标分布，而测量值则提供了约束条件。 我们利用控制方程来定义一个偏微分方程残差能量，并据此构建目标分布，从而对训练场进行采样。这一过程无需依赖由真实世界测量数据或外部模拟器预先构建的完整场数据集。 训练完成后，该模型可作为一个摊销采样器，仅需利用少数空间位置上的稀疏测量值，即可快速估算未观测到的场值，并探索完整时空场的多种合理演化路径。

paragraphs.en: Specially, we introduce PhysDEM , Phys ics- D efined E nergy- M atching Diffusion, for spatiotemporal field generation under scarce measurements. Our mathematical derivation links the PDE residual energy to target distribution construction, denoiser training, and field sampling. In this framework, we define a Gibbs target distribution by reweighting a Gaussian reference that encodes assumed field variability with the PDE residual energy that promotes physical consistency. We then derive an energy-determined conditional-mean diffusion denoiser that implements energy matching by learning the remaining energy-induced mean correction, aligning denoiser training with the physics-defined target. At inference, scarce measurements update the Gaussian reference and denoiser inputs. The denoiser’s predicted mean correction drives our physics-displacement probability-flow sampler , enabling amortized sampling of plausible complete spatiotemporal fields across measurement configurations without retraining. Our main contributions are as follows:
paragraphs.zh: 特别地，我们提出了 PhysDEM（物理定义的能量匹配扩散模型），用于在测量数据稀缺的情况下生成时空场。 我们的数学推导将偏微方程（PDE）的残差能量与目标分布构建、去噪器训练和场采样联系起来。 在该框架中，我们通过重新加权高斯参考分布来定义一个吉布斯目标分布：该高斯分布编码了假设的场变异性，而 PDE 残差能量则促进物理一致性。 接着，我们推导出了一个由能量决定的条件均值扩散去噪器，它通过学习剩余能量引起的均值修正来实现能量匹配，从而将去噪器训练与物理定义的目标对齐。 在推理阶段，稀缺的测量数据会更新高斯参考分布和去噪器的输入。 去噪器预测的均值修正驱动了我们的物理位移概率流采样器，使得无需重新训练即可在不同测量配置下摊销采样出合理的完整时空场。 我们的主要贡献如下：

sents.en: Our main contributions are as follows:

paragraphs.en: We propose a physics-defined and measurement-constrained Gibbs target distribution that enables denoiser training on internally sampled complete fields without requiring a preassembled full-field dataset from real-world measurements or external simulators.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种由物理规律定义且受测量约束的吉布斯目标分布，该分布使得去噪器能够在内部采样的完整场数据上进行训练，而无需使用来自真实世界测量或外部模拟器的预组装全场数据集。

paragraphs.en: We mathematically derive an energy-determined conditional-mean diffusion denoiser through an exact conditional-mean identity, establishing energy matching as supervised learning of the energy-induced mean correction relative to an analytic Gaussian estimate.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过精确的条件均值恒等式，从数学上推导出一种由能量决定的条件均值扩散去噪器，从而确立了能量匹配作为对分析高斯估计值而言的能量诱导均值校正的监督学习问题。

paragraphs.en: We develop an amortized physics-displacement probability-flow sampler that analytically cancels Gaussian reference terms and uses the learned normalized correction as its velocity, accommodating changing measurements through Gaussian conditioning without retraining.
paragraphs.zh: 我们开发了一种摊销物理位移概率流采样器，该采样器能够解析地消除高斯参考项，并将学习到的归一化校正用作其速度，从而无需重新训练即可通过高斯条件化适应变化的测量值。

paragraphs.en: Generative artificial intelligence models support spatiotemporal field generation by learning distributions over plausible field realizations. GANs such as DGMR generate realistic precipitation sequences but rely on large radar archives for training ( Ravuri et al., 2021 ) . PI-GAN incorporates governing equations and ensembles of scattered sensor measurements but remains susceptible to discriminator overfitting ( Yang et al., 2020 ) . FNOPE uses conditional flow matching for function-valued posterior inference but requires paired parameter samples and simulator outputs ( Moss et al., 2025 ) . In comparison, diffusion offers an alternative based on non-adversarial denoising and flexible conditioning ( Song et al., 2020 ) , iteratively refining noisy fields according to learned spatiotemporal dependencies to generate spatially detailed, temporally coherent, and diverse fields ( Price et al., 2025 ; Rozet & Louppe, 2023 ; Rühling Cachay et al., 2023 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 生成式人工智能模型通过学习合理场实现的分布，支持时空场的生成。 GAN（如 DGMR）能够生成逼真的降水序列，但其训练依赖于庞大的雷达数据档案（Ravuri 等，2021）。 PI-GAN 纳入了控制方程和分散传感器测量值的集合，但仍容易受到判别器过拟合的影响（Yang 等，2020）。 FNOPE 使用条件流匹配进行函数值后验推断，但需要成对的参数样本和模拟器输出（Moss 等，2025）。 相比之下，扩散模型提供了一种基于非对抗性去噪和灵活条件约束的替代方案（Song 等，2020），它通过迭代优化噪声场以匹配已学习的时空依赖关系，从而生成空间细节丰富、时间连贯且多样化的场（Price 等，2025；Rozet & Louppe，2023；Rühling Cachay 等，2023）。

sents.en: Generative artificial intelligence models support spatiotemporal field generation by learning distributions over plausible field realizations.

sents.en: In comparison, diffusion offers an alternative based on non-adversarial denoising and flexible conditioning ( Song et al., 2020 ) , iteratively refining noisy fields according to learned spatiotemporal dependencies to generate spatially detailed, temporally coherent, and diverse fields ( Price et al., 2025 ; Rozet & Louppe, 2023 ; Rühling Cachay et al., 2023 ) .
sents.zh: 相比之下，扩散模型提供了一种基于非对抗性去噪和灵活条件约束的替代方案（Song 等，2020），它通过迭代优化噪声场以匹配已学习的时空依赖关系，从而生成空间细节丰富、时间连贯且多样化的场（Price 等，2025；Rozet & Louppe，2023；Rühling Cachay 等，2023）。

paragraphs.en: Physical constraints can enter diffusion models through PDE residual penalties during training ( Bastek et al., 2025 ) or guidance during sampling ( Huang et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2026 ) . However, these approaches generally rely on full-field training data obtained from measurements or forward simulations. A learned-physics approach ( Tan et al., 2026 ) estimates dynamics from observations without fully specified governing equations, but has not been demonstrated for full-field inference from scarce measurements alone. Energy-based diffusion samplers instead learn to sample from prescribed unnormalized densities without precomputed target datasets ( Vargas et al., 2023 ; Akhound-Sadegh et al., 2024 ) , but their original formulations do not explicitly support reuse across varying measurement counts without retraining. Compared with these state-of-the-art methods, PhysDEM provides a physics-defined diffusion framework that samples its own training fields from a PDE-based target and generates complete fields from scarce measurements while accommodating different measurement counts without retraining (see Table 1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 物理约束可以通过训练期间的偏微方程（PDE）残差惩罚（Bastek 等，2025）或采样时的引导机制（Huang 等，2024；Li 等，2026）进入扩散模型。 然而，这些方法通常依赖于通过测量或正向模拟获得的全场训练数据。 一种基于学习的物理方法（Tan 等，2026）从观测数据中估计动力学过程，而无需完全指定的控制方程，但尚未证明其能够仅凭稀疏的测量数据实现全场推断。 相比之下，基于能量的扩散采样器则学习从预定义的未归一化密度中进行采样，而无需预先计算的目标数据集（Vargas 等，2023；Akhound-Sadegh 等，2024），但其原始公式并未明确支持在不同测量数量下无需重新训练即可重复使用。 与这些前沿方法相比，PhysDEM 提供了一个由物理定律定义的扩散框架：它基于偏微方程的目标生成自身的训练场，并能从稀疏测量数据中生成完整的场，同时无需重新训练即可适应不同的测量数量（见表 1）。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate PhysDEM on three synthetic PDE systems (Darcy, advection–diffusion, and Fisher–KPP) and two real-world-informed applications (SPE10 and Bemidji). We compare field recovery from scarce measurements against baselines and examine measurement reuse, ablations, sampling cost, and noise sensitivity. Further case details and data sources are documented in Appendix E.1 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们在三个合成偏微分方程系统（达西方程、平流-扩散方程和费舍尔-KPP方程）以及两个基于真实世界信息的应用程序（SPE10和Bemidji）上对PhysDEM进行了评估。 我们将基于稀疏测量值进行场恢复的结果与基线方法进行了比较，并研究了测量的重复使用、消融研究、采样成本以及对噪声的敏感度。 更多案例细节和数据来源记录在附录E.1中。

sents.en: We compare field recovery from scarce measurements against baselines and examine measurement reuse, ablations, sampling cost, and noise sensitivity.

paragraphs.en: Table 2 shows that PhysDEM attains the highest or tied-highest reported SBC counts across five cases, with observation misfits of 0.96 0.96 – 1.09 1.09 and selected residual ratios of 1.00 1.00 – 1.12 1.12 . Four cases pass all reported mean-rank checks. Its observation misfit is closest to the noise scale in each of the five test cases. This balance is achieved using internally generated training fields, without a preassembled external full-field dataset. Figure 2 shows coherent spatial structure and temporal evolution under scarce measurements. At the displayed well, PhysDEM’s 90% intervals contain the reference at 44 / 48 44/48 times. DiffusionPDE shows late-time mismatch ( 26 / 48 26/48 hits), PIDM underdispersed intervals ( 9 / 48 9/48 ), and FunDPS noisy fields despite tight observation fitting ( 5 / 48 5/48 ). Protocols and additional comparisons appear in Appendix E.2 . Figure 4 separately maps the 1995 mean and spread of log benzene concentration, identifying regions of higher predicted concentration and greater ensemble variability. This illustrates PhysDEM’s practical value for field assessment in a real-world-informed setting; comparison with 147 records used in reference construction remains descriptive.
paragraphs.zh: 表2显示，PhysDEM在五个案例中均获得了报告的最高或并列最高的SBC计数，其观测失配为0.96–1.09，所选残差比率为1.00–1.12。 四个案例通过了所有已报告的均值排名检验。 在五个测试案例中，其观测失配均最接近噪声尺度。 这种平衡是通过内部生成的训练场实现的，而无需预先组装的外部全场数据集。 图2展示了在测量数据稀缺的情况下，模型所呈现的连贯空间结构和时间演化过程。 在所示的井点处，PhysDEM的90%置信区间在44/48次包含了参考值。 DiffusionPDE在后期出现不匹配（命中率为26/48），PIDM的置信区间存在欠离散现象（9/48），而FunDPS尽管对观测数据的拟合紧密，但其生成的场却存在噪声（5/48）。 相关协议及额外比较见附录E.2。 图4分别绘制了1995年苯浓度对数的均值和离散程度，从而识别出预测浓度较高以及集合体变异性较大的区域。 这体现了PhysDEM在基于真实世界情境的实地评估中的实际价值；但与用于构建参考数据的147条记录进行比较时，目前仍停留在描述性层面。

paragraphs.en: Figure 3 shows that PhysDEM adapts to K = 1 , 2 , 4 , 8 K=1,2,4,8 wells using one fixed network per case. From one to eight wells, full-field mean pointwise 90% interval widths decrease by 10.3 10.3 – 23.5 % 23.5\% across all five cases, while observation and residual diagnostics remain near their reference scales. Fisher–KPP’s mean static-field standard deviation falls from 0.470 0.470 to 0.342 0.342 , with lower spread around measured wells. These spatial responses show how scarce measurements reshape the generated ensembles. Measurement changes enter through the conditioned Gaussian reference, allowing the learned denoiser to be reused without retraining. This supports repeated inference across the tested well counts. Protocols and the SPE10 extension are in Appendix E.3 .
paragraphs.zh: 图3显示，PhysDEM 针对 K = 1、2、4、8 的情况，每种情况均使用一个固定的网络来适应这些井。 从一口井到八口井，在所有五种情况下，全场平均点状 90% 置信区间的宽度减少了 10.3–23.5%，而观测和残差诊断指标则保持在其参考尺度附近。 Fisher–KPP 的平均静态场标准差从 0.470 降至 0.342，且测量井周围的离散程度更低。 这些空间响应表明，稀疏的测量值如何重塑生成的样本集。 测量变化通过条件高斯参考模型引入，这使得无需重新训练即可重复使用已学习的去噪器。 这支持了对所测试的不同井数进行多次推理。 相关协议和 SPE10 扩展内容见附录 E.3。

paragraphs.en: We develop PhysDEM for spatiotemporal field generation from scarce measurements without external full-field datasets. Extensive experiments show coherent field recovery, efficient sampling, and stable diagnostics under tested noise levels. Gaussian conditioning enables amortized sampling with changing measurements without retraining, while site-informed cases illustrate real-world value. Weakly informed static fields retain broad uncertainty, limiting unique recovery. Future work will use richer measurements to improve joint static and dynamic field recovery.
paragraphs.zh: 我们开发 PhysDEM，用于从稀疏测量数据中生成时空场，而无需外部全场数据集。 大量实验表明，在测试的噪声水平下，该方法能够恢复相干场、实现高效采样并保持稳定的诊断能力。 高斯条件化使得在测量数据变化时能够进行摊销采样，而无需重新训练；同时，基于站点信息的案例也展示了其实际价值。 信息较弱的静态场仍保留较大的不确定性，从而限制了其独特的恢复能力。 未来的工作将利用更丰富的测量数据，以改进静态场和动态场的联合恢复。

paragraphs.en: The analysis concerns the finite-dimensional field representation in Section 3.1 . Parameter and state fields are modeled jointly, with their physical coupling specified by the residual energy rather than by eliminating u u through a forward PDE solve. Prescribed boundary conditions enter the discrete operators, and available initial values enter the residual vector defined in Appendix B.2.1 . The observation model is linear in the modeled coordinates x x , with positive-definite noise covariances as in equation 2 . In particular, parameter transformations are part of these coordinates: an observation of a log-parameter can be linear in that log-parameter, whereas an observation of the corresponding untransformed coefficient generally is not. The same additive Gaussian noise assumption must hold in the coordinates used by the observation model.
paragraphs.zh: 该分析涉及第 3.1 节中的有限维场表示。 参数场和状态场被联合建模，其物理耦合由残余能量指定，而非通过正向偏微分方程求解来消除 u u。 规定的边界条件会进入离散算子，而可用的初始值则进入附录 B.2.1 中定义的残差向量。 观测模型在建模坐标 x x 中是线性的，其噪声协方差为正定矩阵，如方程 2 所示。 特别地，参数变换也是这些坐标的一部分：对对数参数的观测可能在该对数参数上是线性的，而对相应未变换系数的观测通常并非如此。 观测模型所使用的坐标中必须满足相同的加性高斯噪声假设。

paragraphs.en: This separation allows adaptation to improve the proposal while retaining a fixed target-preserving kernel for subsequent sampling. Finite-chain output is nevertheless approximate: freezing the kernel does not establish equilibration, and thinning does not guarantee independence. For affine residuals, the defect vanishes and every proposal is accepted; consecutive states become independent only at b pcn = 1 b_{\mathrm{pcn}}=1 .
paragraphs.zh: 这种分离使得优化方案成为可能，同时为后续采样保留一个固定的、保持目标的核。 然而，有限链的输出仍然是近似的：冻结核并不能确保达到平衡，而抽稀处理也无法保证独立性。 对于仿射残差，缺陷会消失且每个方案都会被接受；只有当 b pcn = 1 b_{\mathrm{pcn}}=1 时，连续状态才会变得独立。

paragraphs.en: Thus a fixed truncated interval provides a finite conversion between standardized correction error and velocity error. Heun’s second-order convergence holds when the implemented velocity is sufficiently regular on that interval. Training-chain approximation, covariance encoding, Gaussian numerical operations, the learned correction, integration, and truncation together determine the implemented sampling law. The coverage analysis in Appendix D.4.2 accounts for their combined distributional effect through the sampler discrepancy.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，一个固定的截断区间在标准化修正误差与速度误差之间提供了一个有限的转换关系。 当所实现的速度在该区间上足够正则时，Heun 的二阶收敛性成立。 训练链近似、协方差编码、高斯数值运算、学习到的修正、积分以及截断共同决定了所实现的采样定律。 附录 D.4.2 中的覆盖分析通过采样器差异考虑了它们联合的分布效应。

paragraphs.en: The theorem gives average coverage for a fixed model and observation likelihood, with explicit contributions from model discrepancy, sampling approximation, and set construction. Under correct specification, exact sampling, and expected set probability α \alpha , expected true coverage equals α \alpha by conditioning on Y Y . With approximation, equation 91 quantifies the corresponding lower bound. Its finite-discrepancy and support assumptions are essential, and its averaging does not assert the same coverage for every individual measurement outcome. These conditions align the result with the fixed-model conditioning and approximate sampling used by PhysDEM.
paragraphs.zh: 该定理给出了固定模型和观测似然下的平均覆盖度，并明确指出了模型差异、采样近似和集合构建所作出的贡献。 在模型设定正确、采样精确且集合期望概率为 α \alpha 的情况下，基于 Y Y 的条件推断可知，期望真实覆盖度等于 α \alpha 。 在存在近似的情况下，方程 91 量化了相应的下界。 其有限差异性和支撑集假设至关重要，并且该平均过程并不保证每个单独的测量结果都具有相同的覆盖度。 这些条件使该结果与 PhysDEM 所采用的固定模型条件推断和近似采样方法保持一致。

paragraphs.en: This case uses permeability structure from Model 2, layer 10 of the Tenth SPE Comparative Solution Project ( Christie & Blunt, 2001 ) . A window of the log-permeability field is resampled to the 64 × 64 64\times 64 inference grid, centered, and scaled by 0.5 0.5 ; the static prior scales are informed by this selected field. The pressure reference is obtained by solving the Darcy equation ( 95 ) on a finer 256 × 256 256\times 256 grid and block-averaging onto the inference grid. Conditioning values are generated by adding Gaussian noise to log-permeability and pressure at the selected wells. This provides a controlled assessment of field recovery from scarce measurements in a heterogeneous reservoir benchmark.
paragraphs.zh: 本案例使用了 SPE 第十届对比解决方案项目（Christie & Blunt, 2001）中模型 2 的第 10 层的渗透率结构。 对log-渗透率场的一个窗口进行重采样，得到 64 × 64 的推理网格，并以中心对齐、缩放系数为 0.5 的方式处理；静态先验缩放因子由该选定的场提供。 压力参考值通过在一个更精细的 256 × 256 网格上求解达西方程（95），然后对结果进行块平均并投影到推理网格上获得。 通过在选定井点处的log-渗透率和压力数据上添加高斯噪声，生成条件化数值。 这为在异质储层基准模型中，基于有限的测量数据评估油田采收率提供了受控的评估方法。

paragraphs.en: This transport case incorporates field information from the USGS crude-oil spill research site near Bemidji, Minnesota ( Trost et al., 2018 ) . The data comprise 147 benzene records from 38 wells over seven campaigns between 1986 and 1995. Site geometry, well locations, campaign times, and a regional flow estimate inform the problem construction. The advection–diffusion equation ( 96 ) uses site-specific coefficients, a known regional streamfunction plus a scaled unknown perturbation, and an unknown source field. The records inform the source and reference construction, and a forward solve generates the concentration reference. Conditioning values are synthetic noisy measurements at real well locations and campaign times, yielding 56 values at K = 8 K=8 . Comparison with the 147 records therefore assesses agreement with the source data; it is descriptive rather than an independent held-out validation.
paragraphs.zh: 该运输案例整合了美国地质调查局（USGS）位于明尼苏达州贝米吉附近的原油泄漏研究现场的数据（Trost 等人，2018）。 这些数据包括 1986 年至 1995 年间七次勘探活动中 38 口井的 147 条苯记录。 研究现场的几何结构、井位、勘探时间以及区域流量估算值共同构成了问题构建的基础。 平流-扩散方程（96）使用了现场特定的系数、已知的区域流函数加上一个经过缩放的未知扰动，以及一个未知的源场。 这些记录用于构建源场和参考场，而正向求解则生成浓度参考值。 条件化数值是真实井位和勘探时间处的合成噪声测量值，在 K = 8 的情况下得到 56 个数值（K=8）。 因此，与 147 条记录的比较可用于评估其与源数据的一致性；这种比较属于描述性分析，而非独立的预留验证。

paragraphs.en: The eight baselines are task-adapted implementations, summarized in Table 4 . Their learned modules use 4,096 complete training fields and 512 validation fields per case, sampled approximately from the fixed physics-defined target. PhysDEM instead constructs training fields through internal approximate pCN pools. Fixed-reference comparisons share the reference and measurement configuration. The archived FNOPE implementation generates static parameters and completes states by a deterministic forward solve. These results characterize the evaluated implementations.
paragraphs.zh: 这八种基线方法均为任务自适应的实现，具体总结于表 4。 它们所学习的模块在每个案例中使用了 4,096 个完整的训练场和 512 个验证场，这些场大致从固定的物理定义目标中采样得到。 而 PhysDEM 则通过内部近似的 pCN 池来构建训练场。 固定参考比较共享参考和测量配置。 存档的 FNOPE 实现通过确定性正向求解生成静态参数并完成状态。 这些结果描述了所评估的实现方法。

paragraphs.en: Figure 6 uses elapsed batch time divided by the number of generated members, not single-sample latency. The PhysDEM point uses 64 samples in network minibatches of two, EMA weights, 150 Heun steps (300 network evaluations), and a max = 0.995 a_{\max}=0.995 . Its 1.47 1.47 s/member includes sampling, summary-statistic computation, and transfer of those statistics to the CPU; reference construction, residual scoring, and offline training are outside the timer. DiffusionPDE takes 4.38 4.38 s/member in its archived run. Batch sizes and CUDA-graph settings differ across methods; DiffusionPDE and Di-BiLPS times come from imported run records. The comparison therefore characterizes these implementations, not a controlled end-to-end hardware benchmark.
